title: Fed September meeting: Hike rates to fight inflation or heed Trump’s call for cuts — what should Kevin Warsh do?
text: Fed September meeting: Hike rates to fight inflation or heed Trump’s call for cuts — what should Kevin Warsh do?. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh faces pressure from President Trump to cut rates while inflation data suggests a rate hike is necessary. Markets now estimate a 91% chance of a hike, complicating Warsh's balancing act between credibility and political pressure.
